page.overview:
Who is Captain Steimer?

Captain Steimer was a Captain of the Empire who served during the Great War Against Chaos.

Imperial nobility through-and-through, Steimer was cocky, self-absorbed and also a fine swordsman and natural leader of men. Although his disrespectful attitude may have seemed shallow, he was raised from birth to believe in himself, and the long list of loyal ancestors proved his family's devotion to the Empire. He proudly bore his last name, and saw Stefan von Kessel as a jumped up commoner, who should not under any circumstances be allowed command of an armed force. Steimer's laid-back attitude was reflected in his lazy, offhanded method of speech that was more akin to a drawl.

Alas, despite his family's loyalty to the Empire, Steimer secretly served as the personal champion of the Nurgle-corrupted Otto von Gruber. He was later slain in the very same battle that saw Stefan cut down his master.
